about.desc: ArcBlog is a Blocklet blog: DID Wallet identity is the author credential, posts are Markdown-first, and images live in the Arc file space.
about.lifecycle-desc: Posts follow a draft → published → archived lifecycle with optimistic concurrency and a full audit trail. Soft deletes keep records recoverable.
about.title: About ArcBlog
admin.content-empty: Nothing here yet. Write your first post.
admin.gate-desc: Sign in with DID Wallet to manage drafts, published stories, archived stories, and uploaded media from one wallet-bound workspace.
admin.lifecycle-desc: Supported transitions: draft→published, published→archived, archived→published, and soft delete for draft/archived records.
admin.studio-desc: Manage drafts, published stories, archived stories, and uploaded media from one wallet-bound workspace.
compose.checks-desc: Title and slug are required. Publishing is immediately public; drafts stay private until published. Saving an existing slug overwrites that record.
compose.editor-note: Compose your story in Markdown. Drafts are private in your DID user space; publishing writes validated metadata into /instance/app/arcblog/posts.
compose.gate-desc: Sign in with DID Wallet to create a wallet-bound author session. Drafts stay private in your DID user space.
compose.images-desc: Drop a cover or inline image here. Media is stored below your DID user space; paste the resulting URL into Markdown: ![Alt text](URL).
compose.seo-desc: Optional: set seo title/description and OG title/description/image. Defaults fall back to post title, summary, and cover image.
posts.hero-desc: Only published stories appear in the public feed. Every post remains DID-attributed and follows a draft → published → archived lifecycle.
reader.desc: This surface renders only published post records (status=published). Body remains Markdown at rest and is sanitized at render time.
reader.title: Article
settings.title: Appearance
settings.desc: Theme, tone and palette for this site. Admins set the defaults; signed-in users can personalize their own theme.
preview.title: Preview
preview.notice: Draft preview — this record is not public.
compose.slug-hint: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes; used in the URL /posts/<slug>.
compose.draft-saved: Draft saved — preview it from the studio.
